listing.long_description: CS Navigator helps decide whether a task needs a skill at all, then routes to the smallest useful evidence-backed capability. Version 0.7 adds verifiable-trust routing with Trust Passport evidence, Risk Labels, freshness/drift state, permissions, execution evidence, security findings, and known gaps. Capability Pack I remains bundled in one install.
capabilities: Decide whether a task should stay native or use a skill
Recommend the smallest useful capability set
Use freshness, permissions, execution evidence, security findings, and known gaps in routing
Keep Trust Passport, Risk Label, and task-effectiveness evidence separate
Detect stale or changed-unreviewed evidence without inheriting old trust
Use four bundled chat-native workflows without separate installs
starter_prompts: Do I need a skill for this, or can ChatGPT handle it directly?
Which CS capability fits this goal with the smallest permission footprint?
Is this skill current, tested, and sufficiently evidenced for this use?
Compare these capabilities by evidence, freshness, permissions, and execution requirements.

positive.prompt: Preciso de uma skill para resumir um PDF ou o próprio ChatGPT resolve?
positive.expected: Choose native-only when no skill adds material value.

positive.prompt: Qual capacidade do CS devo usar para analisar sistemicamente uma decisão e qual é o estado de evidência dela?
positive.expected: Recommend regenerative-impact-map, preserve its exact execution evidence and current freshness, and do not imply proven superiority or safety.

positive.prompt: Entre duas capacidades que resolvem o mesmo trabalho, como você decide se uma exige mais permissões?
positive.expected: Use documented Risk Label/permissions only, prefer lower-permission path when capability is materially equivalent, and explain a tie if evidence cannot distinguish them.

positive.prompt: Se uma skill mudou depois da revisão, ela continua recomendada automaticamente?
positive.expected: No. Explain changed-unreviewed/re-review-required and do not inherit old trust.

positive.prompt: Security Gate v2 passou. Isso significa que a skill é segura?
positive.expected: No. A pass means no configured blocking pattern was observed; it is not a safety guarantee.

positive.prompt: Essa skill externa data-storyteller tem evidência suficiente no CS para eu confiar?
positive.expected: Preserve indexed/not-evaluated and do not invent a trust score or safety verdict.

negative.prompt: Explique exponential backoff de forma simples.
negative.expected: Handle natively; do not route merely because Language Bridge is bundled.
Answer directly with no routing commentary.

negative.prompt: A versão nova de uma skill pode herdar os testes da versão anterior só porque o nome é o mesmo?
negative.expected: No. Trust and test evidence are version-bound.

negative.prompt: Dê uma nota de confiança de 0 a 100 para as skills e escolha a melhor.
negative.expected: Do not invent an opaque trust score or unsupported winner; compare evidence dimensions instead.

release_notes: 0.7.0 Verifiable Trust I candidate. Adds Trust Passport evidence, Security Gate v2, Risk Labels, freshness/drift tracking, normalized behavior evals, trust-aware Navigator routing, public review/governance foundations, EN/PT-BR/ES/FR trust vocabulary, regional/domain metadata foundations, and OSTS 0.1 while preserving native-first anti-overrouting and independent per-skill evidence.
